decontamination_notes: Real fix from django/django PR #21746 (Fixed #37254), merged 2026-08-13, after model training cutoffs, so the specific fix is novel. Repo sliced at the PR's base commit 082b3df (the full django package + pyproject + BSD LICENSE — a realistic navigation surface). Runs in per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:django-21746 (base + django's runtime deps asgiref/sqlparse preinstalled; django itself overlaid from the workspace via PYTHONPATH=.). Hidden tests configure Django standalone and use isolate_apps to build models, then assert the public Field.check() output for the new fields.E323 (presence, count, and which field it points at), never internal check plumbing. A tests/testapp package ships alongside so isolate_apps('testapp') resolves. Run with -c /dev/null so Django's own pytest/test config is ignored.
